name: Bumble Bee Wild Pink Salmon in Water (Skinless & Boneless)
whyItWorks: Packed with anti-inflammatory marine omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) that actively dampen intestinal cytokine inflammation. Tender, flaky texture melts with gentle chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and flake with a fork. Delicious tossed with warm white rice or served on sourdough bread.
watchOuts: Buy skinless & boneless cans/pouches to avoid hard bone fragments.
